title: WashU faculty receive promotions
summary_en: During the 2026 fiscal year, a number of faculty members at Washington University in St. Louis were promoted from associate professor with tenure to full professor.

title: Leading the Law Review: A conversation with editor-in-chief Caleb Rogers
summary_en: For Caleb Rogers, serving as 2026-2027 editor-in-chief of the Washington University Law Review is both a leadership opportunity and a chance to help shape the scholarship the journal publishes. A third-year law student, Rogers is leading Volume 104 while preparing for a career in commercial finance.
title_cn: Leading the Law Review: A conversation with editor-in-chief Caleb Rogers

title: Sawyer Seminar Lecture Series to launch Sept. 10
summary_en: The Center for the Humanities and the Department of African and African American Studies, both in WashU Arts & Sciences, will launch a yearlong Sawyer Seminar on “Black Studies and the Future of the American University” Sept. 10.
title_cn: Sawyer Seminar Lecture Series to launch Sept. 10
